claim: Ranks visible CSS rules and parent elements with final measurements, reasons, and a rule to test.
where: landing hero, title, metadata, cause-report and how-it-works sections; catalog; package descriptions; demo; README; terms; extension side panel
sandbox: fresh browser context at / and /demo/?demo=1; assert honest rank/shaping copy, the selected element, measurements, ordered causes, parents, reasons, and rules to test

claim: The sample uses only demo-prefixed storage and does not change real data.
where: landing page, demo banner, privacy, README, demo.md
sandbox: fresh browser at /?demo=1; assert redirect to /demo/?demo=1, seed a normal localStorage key, exercise and reset the demo, assert the normal key remains and every new key begins demo:

claim: Core analysis works offline after the first visit.
where: landing first-screen facts, demo, README, demo.md
sandbox: fresh browser context; obtain service-worker control, switch offline, reload the demo, capture again, and assert the result

claim: HTML and JSON exports remove page text and URL query details; selectors can be replaced with labels.
sandbox: download both formats from demo data and assert records exist while page text, query secrets, fragments, and opted-out selectors do not

claim: Capturing again shows measurement and page changes.
sandbox: fresh demo; capture again and assert the exact before/after width delta and recorded class change

claim: Analysis and both export formats are free.
sandbox: fresh context without license state; exercise sample analysis and both downloads and assert there is no payment gate or checkout link

claim: Analysis stays in Chrome with no analytics, page upload, website host permission, or extension network request.
where: landing first-screen facts and privacy section, privacy, README, extension side panel
sandbox: intercept the complete demo flow and assert every request is same-origin; inspect the built manifest for no host permission

claim: The extension requests activeTab, scripting, storage, and sidePanel with no website host permission.
sandbox: build the extension and assert the exact MV3 permission set, no host_permissions, and no content_scripts

claim: The picker starts only when chosen, selects a live element with a pointer or Tab and Enter, and Escape cancels it.
where: landing how-it-works section, privacy, README, extension side panel and picker
sandbox: load the packaged extension against a local fixture, select by pointer, select by Tab and Enter, and cancel with Escape

claim: Stores up to 100 cause reports and private notes in extension storage.
sandbox: load the packaged extension, send a sample report to the side panel, save a note, and assert chrome.storage.local contains the report and note

claim: Clear report log deletes every saved report and private note from extension storage.
sandbox: load the packaged extension, save a report and private note, confirm Clear report log, reload, and assert the storage key and visible report are absent

claim: The production build creates an unpacked MV3 extension, package ZIP, and deployable site with the download.
sandbox: run npm run build, assert all outputs, inspect the MV3 manifest, and test ZIP integrity
